```{r download data}
library(lubridate)

  mutate(
    DateTime = mdy(DATE_TAGGED),
    Date = as.Date(DateTime),
    Full.ID = TRANSMITTER)

  mutate(
    Est.Tag.Death = Date + EST_TAG_LIFE
  )
```

```{r checking for weird detections} 
simultaneous.det <- flounder.det2 %>%
  arrange(Full.ID, DateTime) %>%
  group_by(Full.ID) %>%
  mutate(
    next.time = lead(DateTime),
    next.station = lead(Station),
    time.diff.min = as.numeric(
      difftime(next.time, DateTime, units = "min")
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    time.diff.min <= 3,
    Station != next.station
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
simultaneous.det2 <- simultaneous.det %>%

    DateTime = DateTime,
    preceding_station = Station,
    following_station = next.station,
    time_diff_min = time.diff.min
  )
simultaneous.det3 <- simultaneous.det2 %>%

    sub("_*", "", preceding_station) ==
    sub("_*", "", following_station)
  )
```

```{r system detections}
#this code just checks for system transitions and how long it took the fish to be detected there. 
#i usually sort by time in descending order and give a brief look at the station changes just to see if some make sense
# long times inbetween stations are not uncommon for marine/esturarine fish that may travel offshore
#but long times in between inshore stations can be a red flag

system.transitions <- flounder.det.clean %>%
  arrange(Full.ID, DateTime) %>%
  group_by(Full.ID) %>%
  mutate(
    from_station = lag(Station),
    from_time = lag(DateTime),
    from_system = lag(sub("_.*", "", Station)),
    
    to_station = Station,
    to_time = DateTime,
    to_system = sub("_.*", "", Station),
    
    time_minutes = as.numeric(
      difftime(to_time, from_time, units = "mins")
    ),
    
    time_hours = as.numeric(
      difftime(to_time, from_time, units = "hours")
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(from_station),
    from_system != to_system
  ) %>%
  select(
    Full.ID,
    from_system,
    from_station,
    from_time,
    to_system,
    to_station,
    to_time,
    time_minutes,
    time_hours
  ) %>%
ungroup()

system.transitions2 <- flounder.det.clean %>%
  mutate(
    Station   = trimws(Station),
    sys_group = case_when(
      is.na(Station) | Station == "" ~ NA_character_,
      grepl("LT", Station)           ~ "BI",
      TRUE                           ~ sub("_.*", "", Station)
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(Full.ID, DateTime) %>%
  group_by(Full.ID) %>%
  mutate(
    from_station = lag(Station),
    from_time    = lag(DateTime),
    from_system  = lag(sys_group),

    to_station   = Station,
    to_time      = DateTime,
    to_system    = sys_group,

    time_minutes = as.numeric(difftime(to_time, from_time, units = "mins")),
    time_hours   = as.numeric(difftime(to_time, from_time, units = "hours"))
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(from_station),
    !is.na(from_system),
    !is.na(to_system),
    from_system != to_system
  ) %>%
  select(Full.ID, from_system, from_station, from_time,
         to_system, to_station, to_time, time_minutes, time_hours)
```

```{r loading environmental data}

RIL <- RIL %>%
  mutate(
    value = if_else(unit_of_measure == "uS/cm", value * 0.64 / 1000, value),
    unit_of_measure = if_else(unit_of_measure == "uS/cm", "ppt", unit_of_measure)
  )

MSB <- MSB %>%
  mutate(
    value = if_else(unit_of_measure == "uS/cm", value * 0.64 / 1000, value),
    unit_of_measure = if_else(unit_of_measure == "uS/cm", "ppt", unit_of_measure)
  )

PASC <- rbind(RIL, PAS)

PASC_wide <- PASC %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols     = time,
    names_from  = unit_of_measure,
    values_from = value
  )

BSL <- rbind(MSB, PRL)

BSL_wide <- BSL %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols     = time,
    names_from  = unit_of_measure,
    values_from = value
  )

    id_cols     = time,
    names_from  = unit_of_measure,
    values_from = value
  )

env <- rbind(GPTL, MSB, PAS, PRL, RIL)

env <- env %>%
  mutate(
    value = if_else(unit_of_measure == "uS/cm", value * 0.64 / 1000, value),
    unit_of_measure = if_else(unit_of_measure == "uS/cm", "ppt", unit_of_measure)
  )

env_wide <- env %>%
  group_by(time, unit_of_measure) %>%
  summarise(value = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols     = time,
    names_from  = unit_of_measure,
    values_from = value
  ) %>%
  drop_na()

  summarise(
    n_obs = n(),

    .groups = "drop"

  mutate(
    valid = ymd_hm(valid, tz = "UTC"),   
    mslp  = as.numeric(mslp),           
    date  = as_date(valid)
  ) %>%
  group_by(date) %>%
  summarise(
    n_obs = sum(!is.na(mslp)),
    mslp  = mean(mslp, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(mslp = ifelse(is.nan(mslp), NA, mslp))

    by = "date"
  )

env_final <- env_daily %>%
  left_join(
    pressure_daily %>% select(date, mslp),

  )
```

```{r Objective 1: GLMM: relating env metrics to movement to barrier islands}
dets_toBI <- read.csv("dets_toBI.csv")

# Need to remove the detections from when the fish goes back from BI to another system
#16 unique fish 

dets_toBI2 <- dets_toBI %>%       
  arrange(Full.ID, date) %>%
  group_by(Full.ID) %>%
  filter(first(binomial) == 0) %>%        #removes fish that start at BI
  mutate(
    reached_BI  = cumsum(binomial == 1) > 0,     # TRUE from the first BI row onward
    left_BI     = reached_BI & binomial == 0,    # a non-BI row after reaching BI
    after_leave = cumsum(left_BI) > 0           # TRUE from the first departure onward
  ) %>%
  filter(!after_leave) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-reached_BI, -left_BI, -after_leave)

  semi_join(ToBI2, by = "Full.ID")

BSL.flounder <- flounder_toBI |> filter(DRAINAGE %in% c("BSL"))

Pasc.flounder <- left_join(Pasc.flounder, Pasc_final, by = c("det.Date" = "date"))
BSL.flounder <- left_join(BSL.flounder, BSL_final, by = c("det.Date" = "date"))

flounder_toBI <- rbind(Pasc.flounder, BSL.flounder)

flounder_toBI <- flounder_toBI |> select(-n_obs)

flounder_toBI2 <- flounder_toBI |>
  group_by(Full.ID) |>
  mutate(first_BI = if (any(System == "BI")) min(det.Date[System == "BI"]) else as.Date(NA)) |>
  filter(!is.na(first_BI),
         det.Date >= first_BI - 14,
         det.Date <= first_BI + 14) |>
  ungroup()


ggplot(flounder_toBI2, aes(x = det.Date, y = BI, color = Full.ID)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5) +
  scale_x_date(date_labels = "%b %Y") +
  labs(x = "Date", y = "Location", color = "Fish") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))


glmm <- glmmTMB(BI ~ degC + `ft^3/s` + ppt + mslp + (1 | Full.ID),
              data = flounder_toBI2, family = binomial)

summary(glmm)
```

```{r}
#Quantify Spawning Movements
  #How many move, how many move multiple times, how many don't move
#ANOVA comparing three estuaries

#Do populations from each estuary have different behavior? Residency index from each estuary 
  #Needs to be a weighted residency index because of detection bias

#Things we need 
  #detection days per individual (Di)
  #first and last detection
  #number of monitoring days (Dt) cannot do without receiver info skip for now. use first equation in the RI paper
  #total number of days the animal was detected (Dd)

#What is our spatial scale
  #per receiver -> compare the means
  

#Eliminate the first week of detections for each fish post surgery to remove bias of the surgery

#Need to filter between fish that are actually moving vs not moving

flounder.det.clean <- read_csv("flounder.det.clean.csv")




# =============================================================================
# Residency Index (RI) for acoustic telemetry data
# =============================================================================
# RI = (number of days an animal was detected at a site) /
#      (total number of days in the monitoring period)
#
# Values range 0-1 (1 = detected every day). Three common denominators are
# offered below; pick the one that matches your question:
#   "detection_period" : first to last detection of that animal (all sites)
#   "study_period"     : full deployment window of the array
#   "custom"           : your own start/end per animal (e.g. tagging date
#                        to tag battery end)
# =============================================================================

# ---- Settings -------------------------------------------------------------
denominator <- "detection_period"   # "detection_period", "study_period", "custom"
min_detections_per_day <- 1         # raise to 2+ to reduce false-detection influence
#study_start <- as.Date("2023-01-01")  # used if denominator == "study_period"
#study_end   <- as.Date("2023-12-31")

# Optional: tag-specific monitoring windows (used if denominator == "custom")
# tag_windows <- tibble(
#   tag_id = c("A69-9001-1001", "A69-9001-1002"),
#   start  = as.Date(c("2023-01-15", "2023-02-01")),
#   end    = as.Date(c("2023-11-30", "2023-12-31"))
# )

# command F for Station and switch to System if needed for the remainder of code

#remove all fish that move to barrier island if needed before running (didn't do this, not sure if I was supposed to)

# ---- Clean and add date ---------------------------------------------------
flounder.ri <- flounder.det.clean %>%
  mutate(DateTime = as.POSIXct(DateTime, tz = "UTC"),
         date     = as_date(DateTime)) %>%
  mutate(Month = month(det.Date, label = TRUE)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(DateTime), !is.na(Full.ID), !is.na(Station)) %>%
  distinct(Full.ID, Station, DateTime, .keep_all = TRUE) %>% # drop duplicates
  mutate(
    Station   = trimws(Station),
    System = case_when(
      is.na(Station) | Station == "" ~ NA_character_,
      grepl("LT", Station)           ~ "BI",
      TRUE                           ~ sub("_.*", "", Station)))

# ---- Remove BI and Separate into the Drainage Basins (BSL, Back Bay & Biloxi, Pascagoula)
flounder.ri <- flounder.ri %>%
  filter(System != "BI")

flounder.ri.bsl <- flounder.ri %>%
  filter(DRAINAGE == "BSL")

flounder.ri.bb <- flounder.ri |> filter(DRAINAGE %in% c("BACK BAY", "Biloxi"))

flounder.ri.pasc <- flounder.ri |> filter(DRAINAGE %in% c("PASCAGOULA", "Pascagoula"))

# ---- Separate each drainage into the pre spawn (Aug - Oct), spawn (Nov - Jan), and post spawn (Feb)
ri.bsl.pre <- flounder.ri.bsl |> filter(Month %in% c("Aug", "Sep", "Oct"))

ri.bsl.spawn <- flounder.ri.bsl |> filter(Month %in% c("Nov", "Dec", "Jan"))

ri.bsl.post <- flounder.ri.bsl |> filter(Month %in% c("Feb"))

ri.bb.pre <- flounder.ri.bb |> filter(Month %in% c("Aug", "Sep", "Oct"))

ri.bb.spawn <- flounder.ri.bb |> filter(Month %in% c("Nov", "Dec", "Jan"))

ri.bb.post <- flounder.ri.bb |> filter(Month %in% c("Feb"))

ri.pasc.pre <- flounder.ri.pasc |> filter(Month %in% c("Aug", "Sep", "Oct"))

ri.pasc.spawn <- flounder.ri.pasc |> filter(Month %in% c("Nov", "Dec", "Jan"))

ri.pasc.post <- flounder.ri.pasc |> filter(Month %in% c("Feb"))


# ---- Daily detection summary ---------------------------------------------
# One row per tag x station x day, keeping days that meet the detection threshold
daily.bsl.pre <- ri.bsl.pre %>%
  count(Full.ID, Station, date, name = "n_det") %>%
  filter(n_det >= min_detections_per_day)

daily.bsl.spawn <- ri.bsl.spawn %>%
  count(Full.ID, Station, date, name = "n_det") %>%
  filter(n_det >= min_detections_per_day)

daily.bsl.post <- ri.bsl.post %>%
  count(Full.ID, Station, date, name = "n_det") %>%
  filter(n_det >= min_detections_per_day)

daily.bb.pre <- ri.bb.pre %>%

  filter(n_det >= min_detections_per_day)

daily.bb.spawn <- ri.bb.spawn %>%

  filter(n_det >= min_detections_per_day)

daily.bb.post <- ri.bb.post %>%

daily.pasc.pre <- ri.pasc.pre %>%

  filter(n_det >= min_detections_per_day)

daily.pasc.spawn <- ri.pasc.spawn %>%

  filter(n_det >= min_detections_per_day)

daily.pasc.post <- ri.pasc.post %>%

) %>%

  mutate(days_monitored = max(days_monitored, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%

  arrange(Full.ID, desc(RI))

  ylim(0, 1) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Mean monthly RI", colour = "Station",
```
